trigger.reason: UAE National Center of Meteorology issues a sandstorm (shamal wind) advisory for the desert conservation area; safari operators suspend all afternoon and evening departures for safety

steps.name: Downtown to Desert Safari Meeting Point

original_plan_for_window.quality_note: Entire evening was built around the safari; cancelled outright by the sandstorm advisory, with no partial or on-site indoor alternative

recovery_plans.label: Reorder: Burj Khalifa and Dubai Mall evening instead
recovery_plans.description: Stay downtown and safe from the sandstorm. Spend the evening at Dubai Mall and the Dubai Fountain show, go up Burj Khalifa at dusk, then have dinner at At.mosphere in the same tower.
recovery_plans.tradeoff: Costs 279 more (Burj Khalifa ticket plus fine-dining dinner vs. the safari's flat BBQ price) but finishes 75 min earlier and keeps you entirely indoors downtown, safe from the sandstorm.
recovery_plans.best_for: Travelers who want a landmark-heavy indoor evening and don't mind paying a bit more for Burj Khalifa access

recovery_plans.label: Substitute: skip the desert, explore old Dubai souks
recovery_plans.description: Drop the desert entirely for today. Browse the Gold and Spice Souks in Deira, walk the Al Fahidi Historic District, then have a cheap, legendary dinner at Ravi Restaurant.

steps.name: Al Fahidi Historic District + Dubai Museum

recovery_plans.tradeoff: Saves 305 and over 2 hours; trades dune bashing and a Bedouin BBQ for old Dubai's souks, heritage architecture, and a legendary cheap-eats dinner.
recovery_plans.best_for: Budget-conscious travelers, or those who'd rather explore old Dubai than the desert

recovery_plans.label: Pivot: Marina Walk stroll and overwater dinner at Pierchic
recovery_plans.description: Since the safari included dinner, replace it with a scenic evening instead — a stroll along Dubai Marina Walk followed by overwater fine dining at Pierchic.

baseline_for_comparison.note: Compare against the original safari total (400), which already had dinner bundled in

recovery_plans.tradeoff: Costs 120 more than the cancelled safari (which had bundled dinner) but finishes 150 min earlier; swaps dune bashing for a scenic marina stroll and an overwater fine-dining dinner.
recovery_plans.best_for: Travelers who want a romantic, scenic evening rather than another adventure-sport substitute
